name: jairf-beta
description: JAIRF autonomous beta-testing swarm roadmap (per Autonomous_Beta_Testing_Agents.md guide). Runs continuously across all quarters: discovers crashes, soft-locks, exploits, progression blockers; evaluates combat feel, economy, builder usability, multiplayer stability; simulates player archetypes at scale; produces structured reports for humans + dev agents.

phases.name: 1. Beta Testing Supervisor + archetype pool setup
2. Controlled access tooling (client/headless, logs, screenshots, shared memory)
4. Scheduling (post-integration, overnight, stress before human QA)
